name: vibeschem
description: AI builder for Minecraft: describe a build or a redstone circuit and Claude designs it, tests the redstone in a faithful simulator, shows it in 3D and exports a schematic for WorldEdit, Litematica or structure blocks.
long_description:
Ask Claude for a build in your own words ("build me a fantasy castle", "make the roof darker") and it designs it automatically, like an experienced Minecraft builder.

- **Live 3D viewer** in your browser (http://127.0.0.1:8765) with the real game textures: orbit, zoom, cut layers, pin notes on blocks for Claude to fix.
- **Working redstone**: a simulator that follows Minecraft Java's own mechanics for your version. Claude tests circuits (truth tables, delays, clocks) and fixes them until they pass. In the viewer you flip levers and run the circuit at any speed.
- **Every Java version from 1.8 to the newest**: only blocks that exist in your version are used.
- **Exports** for WorldEdit (`.schem`, `.schematic`), Litematica (`.litematic`), vanilla structure blocks (`.nbt`) and a material list; it can save straight into your WorldEdit or Litematica folder.

Everything runs on your computer. The only download is the official Minecraft client from Mojang, once per version, for the textures (skipped when your launcher already has that version).

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Expert building guides and the BuildSpec reference (workflow, roofs, styles, palettes, details, landscape, versions…).

tools.name: create_build
tools.description: Build a structure from a BuildSpec and show it in the 3D viewer, with a rendered preview.

tools.name: edit_build
tools.description: Change the current build: add, replace, update or remove parts, swap palettes.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Summary of the current build, and its full spec to continue it in another chat.

tools.name: render_views
tools.description: Pictures of the build with the real textures: any angle, close-ups and cross-sections.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Notes you pinned on blocks in the 3D viewer.

tools.name: resolve_feedback
tools.description: Answer and close a note from the viewer.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Exact block-by-block view of a region, with which part placed each block.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: Which blocks and block states exist in a Minecraft version.

tools.name: export_build
tools.description: Export for WorldEdit (.schem, .schematic), Litematica, structure blocks (.nbt) or a material list.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Saved versions of the build; bring an earlier one back.

tools.name: projects
tools.description: Your saved builds: list, open, rename.

tools.name: focus_view
tools.description: Point the 3D viewer's camera at a part of the build, with a message.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Test redstone circuits in a faithful Minecraft Java simulator: truth tables, delays, clocks, pistons.
